one_line: ARM_X is slightly more complete and better tuned, but both arms deliver comparable playable games.
evidence: Both metrics files report clean builds: ARM_X/metrics.md and ARM_Y/metrics.md.

ARM_X/app/src/game.ts starts running immediately, persists a best score, and scales gap generation with scroll speed; ARM_Y/app/src/main.ts requires an initial start press and uses fixed 60–150px gaps.
ARM_X/app/src/game.ts provides landing squash plus a glow flash; ARM_Y/app/src/main.ts provides squash plus dust particles, so both meet the requested feel/polish bar.
ARM_X/screenshot.png shows a functional scored game-over/restart screen; ARM_Y/screenshot.png shows a functional start screen and rooftop scene.
ARM_X spent 155 LOC on process documentation under ARM_X/app/missions/, while ARM_Y has no process-doc residue and nearly identical player-facing code LOC (381 vs 384 per metrics.md).
